description: Startup measurements from the physical Pebble Time 2, one entry per mode and build, taken from the RD startup log line of `PEBBLE_PHONE=<ip> npm run device` or `device:mode1`. scripts/build-report.py copies the newest entry per mode into public/reports/comparison.json.

fields.commit: git commit of the measured build
fields.startupWallMs: wall_ms of the RD startup line (validated slice and gap times); since the time-based startup, about RD_STARTUP_MS
fields.loopMs: loop_ms of an RD_BUILD_PROFILE=1 build, 0 otherwise

measurements.commit: fa2ecb4 plus the uncommitted speed-up changes (-O2, scheduling, rd_row_rgb2, bit-exact core)
measurements.note: First physical run. The startup was interrupted once by a watchface switch, so wall_ms includes a resumed run; the steady rate from the periodic log was 256 steps per 22.5 s. Pebble Time 2 via the phone developer connection.

measurements.commit: fa2ecb4 plus the uncommitted speed-up changes, -O3, RD_BUILD_PROFILE=1
measurements.note: Rate and averages from the RD prof line at step 1027 (rate_x10 562, busy 16896 ms, 105 draws); the phone stopped forwarding logs before the RD startup summary, so startupWallMs is 2000 steps at the measured rate. An earlier -O2 run before the register-held diffusion shares measured 51.0 steps/s and 17.5 ms per step.

measurements.commit: fa2ecb4 plus the uncommitted speed-up changes, version 3 (no dither in mode 1), -O3, RD_BUILD_PROFILE=1
measurements.note: RD prof line at step 1795 (rate_x10 583, busy 27223 ms, 291 draws). startupWallMs is 2000 steps at the measured rate; the startup was then reduced to 1800 steps.

measurements.commit: fa2ecb4 plus the uncommitted speed-up changes: production mode 1 build, version 3, -O3, 1,800 startup steps
measurements.note: RD startup lines: steps 1816 (1800 plus one minute tick), wall_ms 28825, since_init_ms 28836, 219 slices, 110 draws.

measurements.commit: a36458c (digit avoidance with graded kill, LECO)
measurements.note: Baseline before the resolution work, with the digit mask active. The 300-step burst after a minute change took about 4.7 s at the logged rate.

measurements.commit: a36458c plus the uncommitted resolution changes (mode 3, interpolated rendering)
measurements.note: 120 x 136 Q15 with RD_ROW_BILINEAR, 1,250 startup steps, LECO digit mask with one-byte levels. The 300-step burst after the next minute change ended about 7.5 s later by the periodic log.

measurements.commit: a36458c plus the uncommitted resolution and step speed-up changes
measurements.note: After the bit-exact step rewrites (32-bit second product of the reaction, direct nearest Q15 encoding). RD_BENCH phase timing per step: decode 1.2 ms, Laplacian 4.1 ms, reaction 7.1 ms, encoding and store 6.2 ms (18.55 ms), against 1.2, 3.85, 8.45, and 7.6 ms (21.1 ms) before.
Q15 code rows and the error-split table. RD_BENCH step: 17.55-17.8 ms, and 18.15-18.2 ms in a build without the table, against 18.55 ms before both.

measurements.commit: f23328c plus a 100 ms work frame interval and 60 ms slices
measurements.note: 313 draws, about one every 94 ms. A first try that redrew only when 100 ms had passed at the end of a slice gave 173 draws (one every 155 ms) and 26.8 s.

measurements.commit: f23328c plus 100 ms redraws and the faster interpolated renderer
measurements.note: 314 draws. RD_BENCH render of a full interpolated frame into the shared row: 10.35 ms before the renderer rewrites, 8.6 ms after.

measurements.commit: f23328c plus 20 fps pacing, clock text from the core glyphs, the 120-cell render loop, and the size reductions (RD_BUILD_LOG=1)
measurements.note: 623 draws, one about every 50 ms. RD_BENCH render of a full interpolated frame: 6.05 ms (8.6 ms before the 120-cell loop). Load size 19,497 B with logs, 17,233 B without.
32-bit arithmetic on the Q15 codes. 503 draws, one about every 50 ms. RD_BENCH step 14.25 ms against 18.0 ms for version 3 in the same session. Load size 16,449 B without logs.

measurements.commit: 4589677 plus 40 ms redraws with 20 ms slices (RD_BUILD_LOG=1)
measurements.note: 1,330 steps: a minute change near the end raised the pending steps by 80. 664 draws, 23.4 frames per second, two steps per frame; about 26.7 s for the 1,250 startup steps alone. The display-limit build measured the OS ceiling at about 27 frames per second with any draw.

measurements.commit: fff525e plus the three-pass Q15 row loop (RD_BUILD_LOG=1)
measurements.note: 619 draws, 24.5 frames per second, two steps per frame. RD_BENCH step 13.1 ms against 14.25 ms for the single-loop version. Load size 15,045 B without logs. Experiments that did not help on the watch: holding the previous column's residual in a register (14.25 ms, kept), fusing the Laplacian sums into the cell loop (15.45 ms), unrolling the cell loop twice (15.25 ms), and -mcpu=cortex-m33 (14.25 ms).

measurements.commit: fff525e plus the three-pass Q15 row loop, 50 ms redraws with 30 ms slices (RD_BUILD_LOG=1)
measurements.note: 422 draws, 18.6 frames per second, three steps per frame.
The startup ran for RD_STARTUP_MS (30 s): since_init_ms 30,031, 1,653 steps, 555 draws at 18.5 frames per second, three steps per frame.
